sources.title: Commercial Insurance Insights
sources.supports: portfolio analytics, ML claims triage and uploaded client data

financial_anchor.caveat: Half-year and aided by low large-loss experience; not annualized.

ai_claim.claim: Impact+ offers portfolio optimization and ML claims triage using Swiss Re, external and client-uploaded data.
ai_claim.stage: E1 capability; client deployment not quantified
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled loss, quality or retained-cash result.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: H1 underwriting benefited from benign catastrophes and favorable prior-year development while some lines faced price pressure.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not prove AI absence; it blocks aggregate attribution.

rights_limit: Cedent/client data is contract-bound; uploaded portfolio data does not prove cross-client model-training permission.
materiality_summary: Using reported H1 2026 net income of $2.8bn as a same-period after-tax scale, 5% is $140m; it is not annualized. The $4.5bn FY2026 target is kept separate.

arithmetic.inputs: assumed $2bn eligible expense, 15% efficiency, 60% realization, 50% retention, $80m recurring cost and 20% tax sensitivity
arithmetic.result: $10m pre-tax / $8m after-tax sensitivity, below $140m same-period after-tax scale hurdle

g2_provisional: Insufficient: product capability without controlled risk-adjusted outcome or cash capture.
